seo.title: Galileo Health: Virtual Primary Care Review | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Galileo offers 24/7 virtual primary care with a personal care team. $0-99/visit. UnitedHealthcare in-network. Mental health support included.

faqs.a: A virtual primary care service where you get a personal care team (health advocate + lead provider) for ongoing care. Not a one-off telehealth service—Galileo is designed to be your primary care provider. 24/7 access via text, phone, or video.

faqs.q: Does Galileo offer mental health services?
faqs.a: Yes, but it's integrated into their primary care model. They treat anxiety, depression, and insomnia. The care team includes mental health specialists and social workers. It's not a standalone psychiatry service, but good for mental health as part of whole-person care.

Yes. As of 2025, Galileo is in-network with all UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plans across all 50 states. Also available through some employer plans. Cash-pay option available at $0-99/visit.

faqs.q: How is Galileo different from K Health or Sesame?
faqs.a: Galileo assigns you a dedicated care team for longitudinal care—they know your history and coordinate everything. K Health and Sesame connect you to whoever's available. Galileo is better if you want a real ongoing relationship; the others are better for one-off visits.
